meta.title: {app} — Free random video chat with people worldwide
meta.description: Meet new people from all over the world in seconds. Free random video and text chat — no sign-up, in your language.
lang.label: Language
hero.title: Say hi to the *world*.
hero.subtitle: Meet new people from every corner of the planet in one tap. Free, anonymous, no sign-up.
interests.label: Your interests
interests.hint: We'll try to match you with someone who likes the same things.
filter.sameLanguage: Only match people who speak English
consent: I'm 18 or older and agree to the {terms} and {guidelines}.
consent.required: Please confirm you're 18+ and agree to the rules first.
feature.world.title: Worldwide
feature.world.text: Meet people from every continent, with the app in your language.
feature.anon.title: Anonymous
feature.anon.text: No account, no profile, no phone number. Just say hi.
feature.safe.title: Safety first
feature.safe.text: Skip or report anyone in one tap. Zero tolerance for abuse.
feature.fast.title: Instant
feature.fast.text: Matched in seconds, with direct peer-to-peer video.
chat.idle: Ready when you are. Press Start to meet someone new.
chat.searchingTip: Taking a while? Try removing your interests or the language filter.
chat.connected: You're now chatting with someone from {country}. Say hi!
chat.connectedUnknown: You're now chatting with a stranger. Say hi!
chat.failed: Couldn't connect to this person. Finding someone else…
chat.linksBlocked: Links aren't allowed, to keep everyone safe.
self.label: You
report.title: Report this person
report.text: Reports are anonymous. The chat ends right away and you won't be matched with them again.
report.thanks: Thanks for reporting. We'll review it.
report.none: There's nobody to report right now.
settings.title: Settings
settings.blur: Blur new people's video until I tap
media.title: Allow camera and microphone
media.text: Your browser will ask for permission. Your video goes straight to the person you're talking to.
media.denied.title: Camera access is blocked
media.denied.text: Allow the camera and microphone in your browser settings (look for the camera icon in the address bar), then try again.
media.notFound: We couldn't find a camera or microphone on this device.
media.inUse: Your camera is being used by another app. Close it and try again.
error.banned.title: You're temporarily blocked
error.banned.text: Several people reported you for breaking our Community Guidelines. You can come back on {time}.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
error.unsupported: Your browser doesn't support video chat. Please use the latest Chrome, Firefox, Safari or Edge.
error.insecure: Video chat only works on a secure (https://) connection.
error.noscript: {app} needs JavaScript to work. Please enable it in your browser.
